announcement.quote: IN CONNECTION WITH THE PROPOSED FUND MERGERS DESCRIBED HEREIN, EACH ACQUIRING FUND AND TARGET FUND INTEND TO FILE A REGISTRATION STATEMENT ON FORM N-14

deals.notes: The 425 excerpt refers to proposed fund mergers among seven Puerto Rico funds but the excerpts do not say which fund merges into which. Later filings (Dec 2023 and Nov 2024 DEF 14A, Jan 2024 DEFA14A) concern annual director elections and a postponement and do not mention a merger.

problems: Target/acquirer pairing and outcome are not stated in the excerpts.
